quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey praises Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Eric Gordon's contributions
quotes.excerpt: They were really good. Made shots, played great defense.
quotes.quote: They were really good. Made shots, played great defense. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, he has been really steady all season. He has been there every single night. He came off the bench, he started a couple of times, but he has been great for us.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey on the impact of Kentavious Caldwell-Pope this season: He has been really steady all night and has been great for us.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on team's improved offensive spacing and pace
quotes.excerpt: Our spacing was better tonight and our pace was better tonight.
quotes.quote: Our spacing was better tonight and our pace was better tonight. We played with a little more purpose, a little more pep in our step, which is better for us. When we do that, we are hard to guard, harder to guard.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says the Sixers played with more purpose and better spacing tonight: When we do that we are harder to guard.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey praises Joel Embiid's aggressive play
quotes.excerpt: I think he was aggressive. He didn't think, he was just aggressive.
quotes.quote: I think he was aggressive. He didn't think, he was just aggressive. He was getting to his mid-range. He was just aggressive and that is good for him.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid: I think he was aggressive. He did not think he was just aggressive and that is good for him.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey discusses Joel Embiid's knee injury
quotes.excerpt: I knew that he didn't twist it or anything. I knew it was like a knee-to-knee.
quotes.quote: I knew that he didn't twist it or anything. I knew it was like a knee-to-knee. So I wasn't too worried because that was just a contusion. He kept saying, 'I just got kneed.' That still hurts though.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey provides an update on Joel Embiid after his knee injury: I knew it was just a knee to knee contusion so I was not too worried.

quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on De'Anthony Melton's playmaking ability
quotes.excerpt: He is one of our better playmakers and he is really good at just getting downhill.
quotes.quote: He is one of our better playmakers and he is really good at just getting downhill and creating for himself and others. We have to find him more opportunities to do that.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says the team needs to find more opportunities for De Anthony Melton to get downhill and create for himself and others.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the importance of making three-pointers for floor spacing
quotes.excerpt: Anytime we make threes, it opens up space for each other.
quotes.quote: Anytime we make threes, it opens up space for each other. I think that is the biggest thing that we have to do. We have to shoot and make threes. If we are able to do that, then guys get into the paint, create for themselves. Jaylen Brown has more room, Process has more room.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey emphasizes the importance of shooting and making threes to open up the floor for the rest of the team.

structured.context: Tyrese Maxey explains the importance of three-point shooting for team spacing.
